# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 c2 P16](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0016), [v4 c5 P3](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0003)</sub>
- **Titles:** Dr. Blythe  <sub>[v4 c2 P16](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0016)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. As he matures into manhood, he becomes tall, frank-faced, and broad-shouldered, retaining his clear, straightforward hazel eyes. He is noted for his good looks and a strong, well-defined chin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049), [v2 c19 P49](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0049)_

## Personality

Gilbert is determined, ambitious, and possesses a strong sense of duty, both academically and professionally. He has a teasing, playful sense of humor, yet he is deeply sincere, patient, and steadfast in his affections. Highly principled, he holds himself to a high moral standard to remain worthy of those he loves, and he faces challenges with courage and perseverance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027), [v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v4 c29 P16](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0016)_

- Determined  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012)</sub>

- High-principled  <sub>[v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v4 c29 P16](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0016)</sub>

## Abilities

## Goals

- To excel as a doctor and fight disease, pain, and ignorance  <sub>[v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012)</sub>
- To win Anne Shirley's love and build a happy life with her  <sub>[v2 c19 P52](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0052), [v3 c1 P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 c41 P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022)</sub>

## History

Gilbert returns to Avonlea School after years in Alberta and immediately becomes Anne Shirley's chief academic rival after jokingly calling her 'Carrots', sparking a long-held grudge. Despite Anne's snubbing, Gilbert repeatedly seeks her friendship and competes closely with her at Queen's Academy. After graduating from Queen's, he teaches at White Sands and surrenders his application for the Avonlea school so Anne can remain near Green Gables. He later attends Redmond College, where he earns High Honors and wins the Cooper Prize in Classics, while also serving as Freshman Class President and captain of the football team. Following a severe bout of typhoid fever, Gilbert reconciles with Anne, and she accepts his proposal of marriage after realizing her true feelings for him. Upon graduating from medical school, Gilbert takes over his great-uncle's practice in Four Winds Harbor, marries Anne in the Green Gables orchard, and settles with her in a small white house on the harbor shore, where they later welcome their son, James Matthew.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v4 c1 P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c5 P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017), [v4 c34 P2](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0002), [v4 c34 P20](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Son of John Blythe and spent three years in Alberta during his youth due to his father's health  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School, Queen's Academy, and Redmond College  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- Taught school at White Sands to finance his college education  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Quotes

> I'm confessing I made fun of your hair, Anne. I didn't mean to vex you and I only meant it for a joke. Besides, it's so long ago. I think your hair is awfully pretty now—honest I do. Let's be friends.  <sub>[v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031)</sub>

> I want to fight disease and pain and ignorance . . . which are all members one of another. I want to do my share of honest, real work in the world, Anne . . . add a little to the sum of human knowledge that all the good men have been accumulating since it began.  <sub>[v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012)</sub>

> Anne, I love you. You know I do. I—I can't tell you how much. Will you promise me that some day you'll be my wife?  <sub>[v3 c20 P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031)</sub>

> I asked you a question over two years ago, Anne. If I ask it again today will you give me a different answer?  <sub>[v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024)</sub>

> I believe that a doctor is bound to set the sanctity of a patient's mind and body above all other considerations, no matter what the consequences may be. I believe it his duty to endeavor to restore health and sanity, if there is any hope whatever of it.  <sub>[v4 c29 P16](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0016)</sub>
